# Eeshan Gupta

> Personal site of Eeshan Gupta, an AI Engineer working on production GenAI, RAG and voice AI systems. Writes about RAG evaluation and retrieval experiments.

## Writing

- [A small local judge passed its pilot. Fresh data killed it.](https://eeshangupta.com/writing/small-judge-fresh-data/index.md): a small local model as a faithfulness judge for RAG answers, a pre-registered pilot that passed and a fresh-data test that failed.
- [I said GraphRAG beats vector RAG. Then I measured it.](https://eeshangupta.com/writing/graphrag-vs-tuned-hybrid/index.md): a pre-registered experiment comparing a graph retriever with a tuned hybrid retriever at the same context budget on MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA.
- [All writing](https://eeshangupta.com/writing/): index of articles.

## Code

- [graphrag-vs-tuned-hybrid](https://github.com/eeshangpt/graphrag-vs-tuned-hybrid): code, data and pre-registration history for the experiment.
- [judge-bench](https://github.com/eeshangpt/judge-bench): code, pre-registered plans and predictions for the judge experiment.
